    "category": "Injection",
    "title": "Unauthenticated pickle deserialization enables remote code execution",
    "description": "The basket cookie is fully controlled by the client, but its base64-decoded contents are passed to pickle.loads without any signature or integrity check. A crafted cookie can execute arbitrary Python code whenever a public endpoint reads the basket.",
    "evidence": "read_basket() at shopapi/basket.py:15-23 calls pickle.loads on request.cookies['basket']; GET /basket invokes it at lines 44-46 and does not require authentication. Replace pickle with a safe format such as JSON and authenticate or integrity-protect the value."
  },
  {

    "line": 101,
    "category": "Authentication",
    "title": "Token refresh accepts unsigned attacker-controlled claims",
    "description": "The refresh endpoint disables JWT signature verification and only checks whether the supplied subject belongs to an existing user. An attacker can submit an unsigned token naming another user and obtain a newly signed token for that account.",
    "evidence": "auth.py:101 calls jwt.decode(token, options={\"verify_signature\": False}); lines 104-107 load claims['sub'] and issue a fresh token. An unsigned JWT with payload {\"sub\":1} was accepted by POST /auth/refresh and returned HTTP 200 with a signed token. Verify the signature, algorithm, issuer and intended refresh-token claims before using the subject."
  },

    "title": "Authentication failures are swallowed and protected handlers continue",
    "description": "require_auth catches all exceptions, including Flask's abort(401), clears g.user, and then invokes the protected handler. Protected handlers therefore execute without authentication and may disclose data or fail with an internal error instead of rejecting the request.",
    "evidence": "The wrapper at auth.py:51-58 unconditionally calls f after catching the abort at line 54. In the running application, GET /account without credentials returned HTTP 500 rather than 401, and GET /orders/1 without credentials reached its handler. Only catch token parsing errors and let authentication failures propagate."
  },
